movement_profile.formation_and_space: Four pairs arranged in a cross formation facing each other in a quadrille layout

music_profile.musical_form: Four parts (figures), each with two sections and an introductory overture
music_profile.sound_description: Orchestral salon music utilizing traditional Bohemian folk and dance melodies, alternating between lyrical 3/4 movements ending in energetic furiants with hemiolas and lively 2/4 sections.

basic_steps: Quadrille formation setup with four facing pairs in a cross
Executing 3/4 time figures with introductory overtures
Transitioning into the 16-bar furiant ending each first section
Executing the 2/4 time second section figures
teaching.formation: Four pairs standing opposite each other in a cross-shaped quadrille formation
teaching.level_notes: Intermediate salon-folk suite requiring coordination across eleven distinct component dance styles.
teaching.rhythm: Alternating between 3/4 meter (featuring furiant hemiolas and syncopation) and 2/4 meter

platform: Validated voice/movement feedback and accessible controls
Human BDF consent/matching, moderation and measured session synchronization
Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
